title: Jesse's month of bad luck after the visit, including an armed gunman

tellings.quote: building we work at, and an armed gunman runs into the building.

plain: Michels says that after a visit, in a talk about Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, he had a month of bad luck in Los Angeles around 2021 or 2022, including an armed gunman running into the building where he works. He tells this about himself, on an episode with the ranch's owner. The suggestion is that strange trouble can follow people who get close to the ranch.
